messages:
IncidentBot: automated alert - p99 streaming decode latency in us-east-1 spiked to 2.6s (SLO: 1.2s). Affected endpoints: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Auto-paging #eng-oncall.

Alex K.: I see it on the dashboard. p95 also elevated. Any recent runtime/kernel rollouts? :eyes:

Mira P.: yes, we kicked off a kernel rollout to production ~22m ago: rollout id rollout-2026-03-15-2310, TRT9 + FlashAttn v2.1, optimization flags enabled. Canary was green at 10% then rolled forward.

Sam R.: confirmed in CI logs. Mesh-rollout progressed to ~100% ~14m ago. Pausing now.

Jordan L.: customer-impact note: Support flagging streaming timeouts from multiple pro accounts. Need immediate mitigation and comms.

Devon T.: Support - top affected (anonymized): cust-neo, cust-signal, cust-orion. Roughly 1.6% of streaming sessions in us-east-1 in the window, concentrated on long-lived sessions.

Alex K.: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause rollout (Sam), 2) steer new streaming sessions to fallback pool pinned to trt8/flashattn v2.0, 3) increase KV cache retention on fallback, 4) rollback affected nodes to previous image, 5) apply per-route compile-flag kill-switch. Sam/Mira pick items.

Sam R.: pausing rollout: `./rolloutctl pause rollout-2026-03-15-2310` -> done.

Sam R.: routing traffic to fallback pool: `routectl set-target --route /v1/stream --pool streaming-fallback-us-east --weight 100` (applied). Watching traffic shift; new sessions are landing on fallback.

Mira P.: starting rollback job to trt8 image on streaming pools: `deployctl rollback --image runtime:trt8-flashattn-v2.0 --selector pool=streaming-us-east`. Also pushing temporary runtime config change to allow per-route compile flags.

IncidentBot: automated analysis: kernel compile-path flag `-fuse-attn-kernel` (enabled with TRT9/FlashAttn v2.1) reduces avg on short sequences but increases tail for long streams by changing attention kernel memory layout and triggering KV-layer eviction thrash under long prefix retention. Suggest per-route flagging and rollout p99 gating.

Alex K.: that matches our signal (long-lived streams worse). Mira - can you toggle a per-route flag to disable the attn fuse for streaming routes while rollback finishes?

Mira P.: applying hotfix: set `runtime.config.per_route./v1/stream.enable_attn_fuse = false`. Rolling to routing and runtime config.

Sam R.: rollback progress: 40% nodes back to trt8 image -> observed p99 on those nodes drop from 2.6s -> 1.0s. Continuing.

Support Team: sent interim notices to affected customers, stating we are mitigating and will follow up. Reps notified.

Jordan L.: action: keep fallback routing until p99 < 1.2s across entire us-east-1 for 10m. If stable, we can resume targeted rollout with per-route gating. Also raise a runbook PR to add p99 sliding-window check to rollout controller.

Mira P.: runtime hotfix in effect - metrics show KV-evict spikes reduced ~78% on streaming paths. p99 now at ~0.95s cluster-wide in us-east-1 for the last 5m.

Sam R.: rollback complete at 1765005620. Verified no streaming pool nodes on TRT9/FlashAttn v2.1.

IncidentBot: Incident(1765004321) state -> mitigated. Monitoring for regressions.

Alex K.: great work. Next steps (post-incident): - formal postmortem (Jordan/Alex) - implement per-route compile-flag control in runtime (Mira) - add p99 check in rollout controller to auto-pause (Sam/EngPlatform) - improve canary gating for long-tail streaming workloads (SRE/EngRuntime) - customer follow-up and credit offer (Support/Devon).

Devon T.: follow-up emails drafted, proposing 2 weeks of priority support credit for affected customers. Waiting on review.

Jordan L.: I'll own the postmortem and runbook updates. Taking on-call handoff in 25m. If anyone sees late signals, post in this thread. Will post +6h and +24h status updates. :thumbsup:
